textbookText: quality bull is collected and then introduced into the reproductive tract of a female cow (generally into the uterus or cervix)
by using special instruments. The semen may be used immediately or preserved at a very low temperature in liquid nitrogen
for future use. This method allows one bull’s semen to fertilize many cows, increasing the efficiency of breeding. It helps
improve the genetic quality of cattle, ensures better milk and meat production, and prevents the spread of certain sexually
